items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: the last man I know who played the bell trombone was a fella by the name of Willie Connish

ctx.x: Not many. I don't know anybody around town that plays it much now.
Well, the last man I know who played the bell trombone was a fella by the name of Willie Connish. That's the last man I know who played the bell trombone.
Did he ever change the slide? Oh yeah, he changed the slide.
